lines.trans: Hello, Marina Sergeyevna!
What do you need again?
Our organization offers its apologies.
We gladly inform you of the news. Your debt is completely canceled!
Congratulations to you! Konstantin, give her the flowers.
This is a small gift from our establishment.
And one more thing. Eduard Vladimirovich asked us to pass on his regards.
He cannot live without you! In short, he asked you to call.
Yes, please, take the flowers.
And, Marina Sergeyevna, read everything carefully! Especially in fine print!
Not all companies are as kind as ours.
Kostik, what are you smiling at? Because of you I just humiliated myself!
The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.

meanings.note: Common feminine noun meaning 'life' in everyday Russian.
Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to live'.

examples.trans: I live in a communal flat.

examples.text: Я хочу нормально жить! Я хочу биде, понимаешь?
examples.trans: I want to live like a normal person! I want a bidet, do you understand?

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'ведение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'establishment, institution' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Это небольшой комплимент от нашего заведения.
examples.trans: This is a small gift from our establishment.

examples.text: Это очень популярное заведение в городе.
examples.trans: This is a very popular establishment in town.

examples.text: Как ты посмел прийти в моё заведение?
examples.trans: How did you dare to come into my establishment?

meanings.note: polite, or to several people; the first в is silent

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: Из-за вашей Лёли весь класс зовёт меня врунишкой!

examples.text: А трава в мешках сгорела. Из-за вас!
examples.trans: And the herbs in the sacks burned. Because of you!

meanings.en: apology (often plural: принести извинения = to offer apologies)
meanings.note: Prefix 'из-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'винение'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'apology, excuse' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Я пришла принести вам наши самые глубокие извинения.
examples.trans: I've come to bring you our deepest apologies.

meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'кать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to look for'.

examples.text: Ну что, довольна? Теперь новую работу искать.
examples.trans: Well, happy now? Now I have to look for a new job.

meanings.note: как вы знаете = as you know

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: Core Russian pron meaning 'something, a thing or two' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: I want to show you something.

And that is Osipenko's cousin's company!

examples.text: Не все компании такие добрые, как наша.

meanings.note: Common masculine noun meaning 'compliment; complimentary gift' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Это небольшой комплимент от нашего заведения.
examples.trans: This is a small gift from our establishment.

examples.text: Я приношу бутылку шампанского и свечи.

meanings.note: Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'чина'). Common feminine noun meaning 'reason, cause' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Нет причин держать вас под арестом.

examples.text: Нет причин держать вас под арестом. Сегодня вы выйдете отсюда.

examples.text: Когда вырасту, ты будешь просить у меня прощения!

проходить.gloss: to go through; to come in

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

meanings.en: strong, powerful (also used as a noun: the strong)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ильный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('strong, powerful').

examples.text: Сильный ищет способ, а слабый ищет причину.
examples.trans: The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.
A strong wind was blowing outside.

examples.text: Надо заманить его на свою территорию. Там, где ты сильный.
examples.trans: You need to lure him onto your territory. Right where you are strong.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лабый'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('weak').

examples.text: Он же слабый, сразу всё расскажет!
examples.trans: He's weak, after all—he'll tell us everything straight away!

examples.text: Вы никогда не выиграете! Ваш кандидат слабый.
examples.trans: You will never win! Your candidate is weak.

meanings.en: to inform, to report, to announce (+ dat.)
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ообщать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to inform, to report', paired with 'сообщить'.

examples.text: Мы с радостью сообщаем вам новость.
examples.trans: We gladly inform you of the news.
The newspapers report on the election.

examples.text: Мы с радостью сообщаем вам новость. Ваш долг полностью аннулирован!
examples.trans: We gladly inform you of the news. Your debt is completely canceled!

meanings.en: way, method, means of doing something
meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'пособ'). Common masculine noun meaning 'way, method, means' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Сильный ищет способ, а слабый ищет причину.
examples.trans: The strong man looks for a way, and the weak man looks for an excuse.

examples.text: Мы нашли простой способ решить задачу.
examples.trans: We found a simple way to solve the problem.
Then listen, there is a clever way.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?
Nothing! He just sits there smiling.

meanings.en: to humiliate oneself, to demean oneself
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'нижаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to humiliate oneself', paired with 'унизиться'.

examples.trans: Because of you I just humiliated myself!

examples.text: Не надо так унижаться перед ним.
examples.trans: There is no need to humiliate yourself like that in front of him.

examples.text: Костик, чего ты улыбаешься? Из-за тебя я сейчас унижался!
examples.trans: Kostik, what are you smiling at? Because of you I just humiliated myself!
Fresh flowers stood in the window.
Congratulations to you! Konstantin, give her the flowers.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to read', paired with 'прочитать'.

examples.trans: You don't read the small print.
I am reading an interesting book.

examples.text: Женщина, вы мелкими буквами не читаете. Наша фирма в этом не виновата.
examples.trans: Ma'am, you don't read the small print. Our firm isn't to blame for that.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

examples.trans: You have to read the fine print too.
Large print is easy to read.

examples.text: Сказали, что надо читать мелкий шрифт.
examples.trans: They said that you have to read the fine print.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
